findings.title: Undo every derived effect before replaying saved answers
findings.problem: replayOrdered removes the replayed rows and reverses their XP and ability updates, but initializes the replay with their already-updated rewards, daily counter, missSchedule, and streak. Reapplying those answers counts their activity again and can advance an existing review interval twice.
findings.failure_scenario: A device has acknowledged one correct answer taken at time 2000. Another device synchronizes a different correct answer taken at time 1000. When the first device next saves against its one-answer baseline, the merged log correctly contains two answers, but replay starts with the first answer's existing day counters and applies both answers again: daily.answered and rewards.days[day].q become 3 instead of 2. If a replayed answer had already advanced a missed question from a 1-day to a 3-day interval, replay advances it again to 7 days.
findings.fix: Replay from a complete checkpoint preceding the affected suffix, or reverse all effects of that suffix before replaying it—not only XP and ability. Add delayed-answer reconciliation tests asserting daily counters, reward-day totals, streaks, and exact review intervals alongside XP and theta.

findings.title: Reconcile card-only activity into the streak
findings.problem: The function computes activity days from cardOps, but combines those days into a streak only inside the `if (unseen)` branch for new question answers. With card-only changes, it instead chooses one device's entire streak, discarding study days recorded by the other device.
findings.failure_scenario: Both devices load a Sunday streak of 5 with the shield ready. One device studies cards Monday and saves a streak of 6. The other studies cards Tuesday from its stale Sunday state, locally consuming the shield and reaching 6. Synchronizing the Tuesday device retains both card operations but persists count 6 with the shield spent; the combined history should produce count 7 with the shield ready.
findings.fix: Reconcile chronological activity whenever either question attempts or card operations changed, including card-only conflicts. Derive the resulting streak from the shared baseline and combined activity days. Add a two-device card-only test covering consecutive days and shield preservation.

findings.title: Advance the revision when restoring the backup
findings.problem: The rollback updates blob and updated_at without changing revision. Migration 022 installs a BEFORE UPDATE trigger that rejects every update whose revision does not increase, so this rollback cannot execute after the complete change is deployed.
findings.failure_scenario: An operator runs the supplied rollback to recover from an incorrect legacy relabel. The first matching progress row raises `progress revision conflict`, aborting the transaction and restoring nothing.
findings.fix: Make the administrative restore compatible with the guard, such as by incrementing each live row's revision during restoration. Test the rollback against a database with migrations 020–022 installed and verify that subsequent client saves reconcile safely.

assessment: Do not merge. Two reconciliation paths can corrupt saved progress, and the supplied rollback is incompatible with the new revision guard. These findings are from static review; tests and migrations were not executed.
